words.root_logic: anti-（ante- 在前）+ cip（capere 拿）→ 提前把它拿到手
words.origin: 拉丁语 anticipare（先取），过去分词 anticipatus ← ante-（在前）+ capere（拿住）
words.native_definition: to expect something and get ready for it before it happens
words.core_concept: taking hold of it before it arrives – 在它到来之前先拿到手
words.core_image: 客人还没到，桌上的碗筷已经摆好了
examples: We anticipate a rise in prices next year.
She anticipated my question and answered first.
semantic_expansions: 预料：事情还没来，心里先把它拿住
预期：把先拿住的那件事当成会来的来算
提前应对：既已先拿到手，就先动手安排
words.recall_hint: anti-（在前）+ cip（拿）→ 先一步把它拿到手

words.root_logic: cap（capere 容纳、拿）+ -acity（能…的性质）→ 装得下多少的那个量
words.origin: 拉丁语 capacitas ← capax（装得下的）← capere（拿住、容纳）
words.native_definition: the amount something can hold, or the ability to do something
words.core_concept: how much it can hold – 它能装下多少
words.core_image: 量杯上刻着一道线，水到那道线就不能再加了
examples: The tank has a capacity of forty litres.
She has a great capacity for hard work.
semantic_expansions: 容量：容器装得下的那个量
能力：一个人装得下多少事，即办得成多少
生产力：一处厂房在一段时间里装得下多少产出
words.recall_hint: cap（容纳）+ -acity → 装得下多少的那个量

words.root_logic: audi（audire 听）+ -ence（名词）→ 在场听的那一群人
words.origin: 拉丁语 audientia（倾听）← audire（听）
words.native_definition: the people who listen to or watch something
words.core_concept: the gathered listeners – 聚在一处接收的那些人
words.core_image: 台下几百张脸都朝着一个方向，灯一暗就没人说话了
examples: The audience clapped for a full minute.
This magazine has a young audience.
semantic_expansions: 听众：来听的那一群
观众：同一群人，改成看
读者群：不在场，但同样是接收的那一群
words.recall_hint: audi（听）+ -ence → 聚在一处接收的那一群人

words.root_logic: audi（audire 听）+ -t（过去分词）→ 当众念账、一条条听过 → 核查账目
words.origin: 拉丁语 auditus（一场听审）← audire（听）；旧时核账要把账目当众念出来
words.native_definition: an official examination of accounts; to carry out such an examination
words.core_concept: accounts read aloud and checked line by line – 账目一条条念出来听过
words.core_image: 账本摊开，一条条念出来，桌那头的人拿笔逐条对
examples: The company failed its annual audit.
He audits the course without taking exams.
semantic_expansions: 审计：把账目一条条过一遍这件事
查账：具体逐条核对的那个动作
旁听：只坐着听，不算成绩
words.recall_hint: audi（听）+ -t → 当众念出、一条条听过并核对

words.root_logic: audit（audire 听）+ -orium（场所）→ 专为听而造的那个场所
words.origin: 拉丁语 auditorium（听讲之所）← audire（听）
words.native_definition: the part of a building where people sit to listen or watch
words.core_concept: the room built for listening – 专为听而造的那间屋子
words.core_image: 一排排座位顺着坡往上升，最后一排也听得清台上的话
examples: The auditorium seats eight hundred people.
We waited in the auditorium until seven.
semantic_expansions: 礼堂：整座为听讲而造的屋子
观众席：屋里坐着听的那一片座位
words.recall_hint: audit（听）+ -orium（场所）→ 为听而造的那处地方

words.root_logic: cas（cadere 落）→ 落到眼前的那一桩事
words.origin: 古法语 cas ← 拉丁语 casus（落下来的事）← cadere（落下）；表箱盒的 case 出自 capsa，与此不同源
words.native_definition: a particular situation or instance, also a matter dealt with by a court
words.core_concept: what has fallen out in this instance – 落到眼前的这一桩
words.core_image: 门诊记录一页一页翻过，这一页写的是这一个人的经过
examples: In that case we should leave early.
The police closed the case last week.
semantic_expansions: 情况：事情落成的那个样子
事例：单独拿出来看的那一桩
案件：落到法庭上的那一桩
collocations: in case sth happens —— 万一发生某事，用来作预防
in any case —— 无论如何，转折后收束
in the case of sth —— 就某事而言，限定范围
words.recall_hint: cas（落）→ 落到眼前、要单独处理的这一桩

words.root_logic: cas（cadere 落）+ -al → 碰巧落下来的 → 偶然的，进而不当正事对待的
words.origin: 中古英语 casuel ← 古法语 casuel ← 晚期拉丁语 casualis（碰巧的）← casus ← cadere（落下）
words.native_definition: not planned or formal; relaxed in manner or dress
words.core_concept: however it happens to fall – 碰巧落成什么样就什么样
words.core_image: 他穿着家里那件旧毛衣就来了，谁也没打领带
examples: He wore casual clothes to the office.
It was only a casual remark.
semantic_expansions: 偶然的：碰巧落下来、没安排过的
随意的：不当正事对待，怎么方便怎么来
临时的：只这一回落到手上，不算长期
words.recall_hint: cas（落）+ -al → 碰巧落成的样子，不刻意

words.root_logic: dif-（dis- 不）+ ficult（facilis 易做的 ← facere 做）→ 不容易做成的
words.origin: 拉丁语 difficilis：dis-（不）+ facilis（易做的）← facere（做）；英语 difficult 由 difficulty 反推而成
words.native_definition: not easy to do, understand, or deal with
words.core_concept: not easy to get done – 做不成、推不动
words.core_image: 螺丝拧到一半就不动了，换了三把扳手还是转不过去
examples: This question is difficult for beginners.
He can be difficult to please.
semantic_expansions: 困难的：事情做不成、推不动
难对付的：人也一样推不动，不好伺候
words.recall_hint: dif-（不）+ ficult（易做）→ 不易做成

words.root_logic: dif-（不）+ ficul（facilis 易做 ← facere 做）+ -ty（名词）→ 做不成这件事本身
words.origin: 拉丁语 difficultas ← difficilis：dis-（不）+ facilis（易做的）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: the state of being hard to do, or a problem that makes something hard
words.core_concept: the thing that makes it not easy to do – 使事情做不成的那一处
words.core_image: 路上横着一块石头，车过不去，人围着它想办法
examples: She solved the problem without difficulty.
They ran into serious financial difficulties.
semantic_expansions: 困难：做不成这件事的状态
难题：具体挡在那里的那一件
困境：一时出不来的处境
words.recall_hint: dif-（不）+ ficul（易做）+ -ty → 做不成的状态，或挡路的那一件

words.root_logic: cours（currere 跑）→ 一路跑过去画出的那条线
words.origin: 古法语 cors ← 拉丁语 cursus（跑动、路程）← currere（跑）
words.native_definition: a route or direction; a series of lessons; the way something develops
words.core_concept: the line something runs along – 一路跑下来的那条线
words.core_image: 河道在地图上拐了个大弯，水只能顺着这条线走
examples: The river changed its course after the flood.
She signed up for a summer course.
semantic_expansions: 路线：跑过去所走的那条线
过程：事情顺着时间跑过的那一段
课程：一门课按次序排下来的那一串
collocations: of course —— 当然，认作理所当然
in the course of sth —— 在某事进行的过程中
a course in sth —— 某科目的课
words.recall_hint: cours（跑）→ 一路跑下来画出的那条线

words.root_logic: dis-（来回、四处）+ course（currere 跑）→ 话头来回跑动
words.origin: 拉丁语 discursus（来回奔走）← discurrere：dis-（四处）+ currere（跑）；中世纪起转指话头往来
words.native_definition: serious talk or writing on a subject
words.core_concept: talk running back and forth – 话头来回跑动
words.core_image: 两人隔着桌子来回搭话，一句接一句，谁也没停
examples: Her discourse on climate lasted an hour.
They discoursed on politics all evening.
semantic_expansions: 交谈：话在两人之间来回跑
论述：话头顺一个题目一路跑下去
话语：跑出来的那一串话本身
words.recall_hint: dis-（来回）+ course（跑）→ 话头来回跑动的那一串

words.root_logic: com-（一并）+ prehens（prehendere 抓）+ -ion → 把整件事一把抓全的那份本事
words.origin: 拉丁语 comprehensio ← comprehendere：com-（一并）+ prehendere（抓住）
words.native_definition: the ability to understand something fully
words.core_concept: getting the whole of it into one grasp – 把整件事一把抓全
words.core_image: 读第三遍时，前后几句忽然扣在一起，心里亮了
examples: The test measures reading comprehension.
This is quite beyond my comprehension.
semantic_expansions: 理解力：能一把抓全的那份本事
领悟：抓住那一下的感觉
words.recall_hint: com-（一并）+ prehens（抓）+ -ion → 一把抓全的那份本事

words.root_logic: com-（一并）+ prehens（prehendere 抓）+ -ive → 一把抓全的，没有漏下的
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 comprehensivus ← comprehendere：com-（一并）+ prehendere（抓住）
words.native_definition: including everything or nearly everything
words.core_concept: taking in the whole of it – 一把抓全，不漏
words.core_image: 一张网撒下去，池子里连最小的鱼也没漏
examples: The report gives a comprehensive account.
She took a comprehensive medical exam.
semantic_expansions: 全面的：各处都抓到，没有漏下的
综合的：把分开的几处一并抓进同一处
words.recall_hint: com-（一并）+ prehens（抓）+ -ive → 抓得全、没漏下的

words.root_logic: de-（去掉）+ spair（sperare 盼望）→ 把所盼的全撤掉
words.origin: 古法语 desespeir ← 拉丁语 desperare：de-（去掉）+ sperare（盼望）
words.native_definition: the feeling of having lost all hope; to lose all hope
words.core_concept: hope taken away – 所盼的被撤空
words.core_image: 电话响了七次都没人接，他把听筒放下，坐在门口不动了
examples: She gave up the search in despair.
He despaired of ever finding work.
semantic_expansions: 绝望：所盼的全撤掉，一点不剩
失望：盼的落了空，程度轻些
collocations: in despair —— 绝望地，多作状语
despair of doing sth —— 对做成某事不再抱指望
words.recall_hint: de-（去掉）+ spair（盼望）→ 所盼被撤空

words.root_logic: agri（ager 田）+ culture（colere 照管到长出东西）→ 照管田地使它长出收成
words.origin: 拉丁语 agricultura ← agri cultura（田地的照管）：ager（田）+ cultura ← colere（耕作、住下照管）
words.native_definition: the practice of farming and growing crops
words.core_concept: tending the land until it yields – 照管一块地直到它长出东西
words.core_image: 一垄一垄的地翻过、浇过，秋天贴地割下一茬
examples: Agriculture employs most people in that region.
Modern agriculture depends heavily on machines.
semantic_expansions: 农业：靠照管田地取得收成这一行
耕作：翻地、浇水、照管那一套具体的活
words.recall_hint: agri（田）+ culture（照管到长出）→ 照管田地取收成

words.root_logic: con-（一并）+ cert（certare 较量、争出定论 ← certus 已定）→ 各方定到同一个准上
words.origin: 意大利语 concerto（合奏、和谐）← 拉丁语 concertare：com-（一并）+ certare（较量、争出定论）← certus（已定的）
words.native_definition: a public musical performance, or agreement in action
words.core_concept: parties settled onto one and the same measure – 各方定到同一个准上
words.core_image: 台上十几件乐器，指挥手一落，全体同时进同一个拍子
examples: They played at a concert last night.
The two states acted in concert.
semantic_expansions: 协同：各方定到同一个准上一起动
音乐会：许多人定在同一个拍子上奏出来的那一场
演奏会：同一场事，偏说奏这件事本身
collocations: in concert with sb —— 与某人协同一致地行动
words.recall_hint: con-（一并）+ cert（争出定论）→ 定到同一个准上

words.root_logic: claus（claudere 关闭）+ -e → 合上口、自成一段的那一截
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 clausa（一段合上的话）← 拉丁语 claudere（关闭、封住）
words.native_definition: a part of a sentence with its own verb; a section of a legal document
words.core_concept: a stretch closed off into one unit – 合上口、自成一段的那一截
words.core_image: 合同上第三行到第五行用括号圈住，单成一段，签字只认这一圈
examples: This clause explains who pays the fee.
The long sentence has two clauses.
semantic_expansions: 从句：句子里自成一段、有自己动词的那一截
条款：文件里单独合成一条的那一款
words.recall_hint: claus（关闭）+ -e → 合上口自成一段的那一截

words.root_logic: con-（一并）+ crete（crescere 生长）→ 长到一起、凝成实的一块
words.origin: 拉丁语 concretus（长在一起、凝固的），concrescere 的过去分词：com-（一并）+ crescere（生长）
words.native_definition: solid and real rather than general; also a hard building material
words.core_concept: grown together into one solid mass – 长到一起、凝成一整块
words.core_image: 灰浆倒进模子，第二天用锤子敲，声音是实的
examples: Give me a concrete example, please.
The path is made of concrete.
semantic_expansions: 具体的：凝成一块摸得着的，不是散着的空话
混凝土：真凝成一块的那种建材
words.recall_hint: con-（一并）+ crete（生长）→ 长到一起凝成实的一块

words.root_logic: con-（一并）+ dit（dicere 说）+ -ion → 双方一并说定的那一条
words.origin: 拉丁语 condicio（说定的事项）← condicere：com-（一并）+ dicere（说）
words.native_definition: something required before another thing can happen; also the state something is in
words.core_concept: the point spoken and settled between parties – 双方一并说定的那一条
words.core_image: 两人把话说定，写在纸上按了手印，事情才照这张纸走
examples: The old car is in good condition.
They agreed on one condition only.
semantic_expansions: 条件：事先说定、要先满足的那一条
条款：写进文件的那一条
状况：一件东西眼下所处的样子，即事先说定的那些点如今落成什么样
collocations: on condition that + 从句 —— 条件是，引出前提
on no condition —— 决不，置于句首要倒装
words.recall_hint: con-（一并）+ dit（说）+ -ion → 一并说定的那一条

words.root_logic: arti（ars 手艺）+ fic（facere 做）+ -ial → 靠手艺做出来的，不是自己长的
words.origin: 拉丁语 artificialis ← artificium ← artifex（匠人）：ars（手艺）+ -fex（做的人）← facere（做）
words.native_definition: made by people rather than occurring in nature
words.core_concept: made by craft, not grown of itself – 手艺做出来的，不是自己长的
words.core_image: 花瓶里的那束花一年了还没谢，凑近看花瓣是布的
examples: The lake is entirely artificial.
Her smile looked artificial to me.
semantic_expansions: 人造的：人靠手艺做出来的
假的：做出来充作真的那一种
做作的：神情也是做出来的，不自然
words.recall_hint: arti（手艺）+ fic（做）→ 靠手艺做出来，不是自然长的

words.root_logic: co-（com- 完全）+ gnit（gnoscere 认得出）+ -ive → 与认得出这是什么有关的
words.origin: 中世纪拉丁语 cognitivus ← 拉丁语 cognitus（认得的），cognoscere 的过去分词：com-（完全）+ gnoscere（认下来）
words.native_definition: relating to thinking, knowing, and understanding
words.core_concept: to do with coming to know a thing – 与认得出这是什么有关
words.core_image: 孩子把三角块对着孔转了两下，忽然找准了角度塞进去
examples: Poor sleep affects cognitive performance badly.
The test measures basic cognitive skills.
semantic_expansions: 认知的：与辨认、知道这一过程有关
认识的：偏指获得知识那一面
words.recall_hint: co-（完全）+ gnit（认得出）+ -ive → 与认得出这是什么有关

words.root_logic: de-（彻底）+ pict（pingere 涂色）→ 一笔笔敷上去，把那样东西现出来
words.origin: 拉丁语 depictus，depingere 的过去分词：de-（彻底）+ pingere（涂画）
words.native_definition: to show or describe something in words or pictures
words.core_concept: laying colour on until the thing shows – 一笔笔敷上去，把那样东西现出来
words.core_image: 他在纸上把那条街一笔笔画出来，连门口的台阶都对得上
examples: The painting depicts a winter market.
The novel depicts life after the war.
semantic_expansions: 描绘：用画把它现出来
描写：改用文字，一样是一笔笔现出来
words.recall_hint: de-（彻底）+ pict（涂色）→ 一笔笔敷上去把它现出来

words.root_logic: ap-（ad- 朝）+ propri（proprius 专属的）+ -ate → 对上这一处专该有的那一种；作动词则是划归专有
words.origin: 晚期拉丁语 appropriatus ← appropriare：ad-（朝）+ proprius（自己的、专属的）
words.native_definition: suitable for a situation; also to take something for one own use
words.core_concept: matched to what this case properly calls for – 对上这一处专该有的那一种
words.core_image: 婚礼上他换了那身深色衣服，前一件太花，对不上场面
examples: That remark was not appropriate here.
The council appropriated funds for repairs.
semantic_expansions: 适当的：对上这场合专该有的那一种
挪用：把公家的东西划成自己专有的
拨给：把款项划归某一处专用
words.recall_hint: ap-（朝）+ propri（专属）+ -ate → 对上这处专该有的，或划归专有

words.root_logic: con-（完全）+ quer（quaerere 寻求）→ 一路追索到底并把它拿下
words.origin: 古法语 conquerre ← 通俗拉丁语 conquaerere ← 拉丁语 conquirere：com-（完全）+ quaerere（寻求、搜求）
words.native_definition: to take control of a place or people by force
words.core_concept: seeking pressed all the way to taking control – 追索到底，把它拿到手里
words.core_image: 城门开了，旗子换成另一面，街上的人照新规矩过日子
examples: Rome conquered most of the region.
She conquered her fear of water.
semantic_expansions: 征服：追索到底，把地方或人拿下
攻克：偏说攻下那一处的动作
克服：把困难当成要拿下的对象，一样追到底
words.recall_hint: con-（完全）+ quer（寻求）→ 追索到底并拿下

words.root_logic: di-（dis- 分开）+ stress（stringere 拉紧）→ 从两边往外扯紧，绞得动不了
words.origin: 古法语 destresse ← 通俗拉丁语 districtia ← 拉丁语 districtus，distringere 的过去分词：dis-（分开）+ stringere（拉紧）
words.native_definition: great pain or worry; also serious trouble or danger
words.core_concept: drawn tight from both sides until it hurts – 从两边扯紧，绞得难受
words.core_image: 绳子从两头往外拉，中间那段越收越细，人喘不上气
examples: The news caused her great distress.
A ship in distress sent up signals.
semantic_expansions: 痛苦：被绞紧那一下的感觉
忧虑：心里一直被拉着，松不开
困境：被绞在中间、出不来的处境
collocations: in distress —— 处于危难中，常说船只或人
words.recall_hint: di-（分开）+ stress（拉紧）→ 从两边扯紧、绞得出不来

words.origin: 法语 caisse（钱箱）← 意大利语 cassa ← 拉丁语 capsa（箱、钱柜）；本项目未为 capsa 一支建根
words.native_definition: money in the form of notes and coins
words.core_concept: the money kept in the box – 箱格里放着的那些钱
words.core_image: 抽屉一拉开，里面按面值分格摆着一叠叠纸票和硬币
examples: He paid the whole bill in cash.
She cashed the cheque this morning.
semantic_expansions: 现金：钱箱里放着的、当场付得出的那些
